name: Sietch Reverend Mother
text:
[When Played:] Choose a [{Fremen}] or [{Bene Gesserit}] unit in your discard pile other than a Sietch Reverend Mother. Use its [When Played] ability as if it were this unit's.
[When Defeated:] Return another [{Fremen}] or [{Bene Gesserit}] unit from your discard pile to your hand.
